app.title: Grosoq
app.subtitle: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe Race Result Automatic Acquisition & Analysis Application

config.title: Settings
config.obsSourceDropdownHint: * Connect to OBS to select from list
config.modelsVisionNo: Likely does not support image input
config.modelsNeedKey: Enter and save your Groq API key to load the model list.
config.modelsHint: * Vision support is estimated from model IDs. Check Groq's documentation for the latest availability.
config.analysisModeStandardHelp: Calculates points from the rank on the results screen and adds them
config.analysisModeStandingsHelp: Reads cumulative scores directly from the pre-race standings screen
config.analysisModeHelp: * Standings mode analyzes only the left half of the capture and overwrites current scores with the read values. Make sure the correct screen is being captured.
config.calHint: Enclose only the region containing names and scores. Anything outside (badges/stickers) is excluded from analysis. Values are % of full capture width.
config.validationError: OBS settings and Groq API key are required

scoreSettings.title: ⚙️ Score Settings
scoreSettings.keepScoresHelp: When turned off, scores will be automatically reset when the app starts

overlaySettings.title: 🖥️ Overlay Settings
overlaySettings.showRemainingRacesHelp: When turned off, remaining race count will not be displayed on the overlay
overlaySettings.scoreEffectColorHelp: Customize the color of the flash effect when team scores increase
overlaySettings.currentPlayerColorHelp: Customize the border color to distinguish your own team

usage.title: 💡 How to Use
usage.steps:
1. Enter and save the settings above
2. Click 'Open Overlay' to open browser
3. Set that URL as OBS browser source
4. Click 'Fetch Race Results' button on the race result screen
